title: PR #222: [Draft] Add machine-readable ecosystem file/function inventory
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

## Summary
Adds the initial governance-side catalog structure for a file-by-file ecosystem inventory:
- repository manifest with explicit pending state for unscanned repositories
- JSONL file-record schema with commit/blob provenance, symbols, callers, dependencies, tests and verification status
- coverage report that distinguishes tracked-file counts from semantic analysis
- evidence-bound dependency graph seed
- three targeted Genesis Engine file records from prior read-only inspection

## Evidence and limitations
- Initial organization discovery listed 33 repositories.
- Recursive trees were captured for 8 repositories (7,741 tracked files); this is not complete organization coverage.
- Only 3 file records are seeded; the full file-by-file analysis has NOT been performed.
- Most repositories still require exact HEAD/tree capture and semantic scanning.
- No implementation source-of-truth, standards registry, or demo drift-gate policy is changed.

## Acceptance gates before marking complete
- All repositories have exact default-branch commit SHA and recursive tree evidence.
- One validated record per tracked file or an explicit documented exclusion.
- Symbol/caller/dependency and test evidence tied to exact commits/blobs.
- Schema validation and deterministic regeneration CI pass.
- No merge until evidence supports the claimed coverage.
